resources.string: Mirror this Android screen to OpenMirrorPhone on Windows. No account needed.
Scan the QR code in Windows to save this PC, or enter its address. Tap Start capture when you are ready to share. Supported app audio can stream too; the microphone is not captured.
The free Windows app, the same one used by iPhone.
Phone and PC need to be on the same network.
Android asks before anything on screen is captured.

Open the Windows receiver and scan its QR code here to save the PC address. This does not start sharing. Tap Start capture when ready, then approve Android screen sharing and, if enabled, audio capture. Video and supported app audio stream over your local network. Automatic PC discovery is not included yet; some apps may block audio capture.

Android asks before screen capture starts. When Stream app audio is enabled, it requests audio permission for app playback capture, not microphone recording. Captured screen and supported app audio go directly to the PC on your local network and are not encrypted. Use a trusted network. A persistent notification lets you stop sharing.
